title: Engraved Planks
description: Adds a new decorative subvariant of wooden planks.
body:
This mod adds a decorative new sub-variant of your normal vanilla wooden planks, engraved planks. Engraved planks are a great new way to add patterns to your house or just to build a cool looking mansion! 

Engraved planks can be crafted by combining 9 wooden planks of one type in a crafting table, and you will receive 9 engraved planks!
(e.g; Oak Planks make Engraved Oak Planks)

Please share this mod with your friends so I can get money! Also, I am planning to update this to the latest version of minecraft, so expect compatibility with Minecraft 1.21.11 soon!
![A picture of the different types of engraved planks added in this mod, next to their normal vanilla counterparts.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/06527fc5b4d2bc406f87f1d6f860a662d6a9fdf5.png)
